artifactChatOpenInCode: Open the full conversation in Code
artifactChatBindingSourceHint: Keeps all the context that made this file
artifactChatFooter: Changes go straight into the file, and every turn can be undone.
artifactChatEmptyTitleSlides: What should change in this deck?
artifactChatEmptyTitleDoc: What should change in this document?
artifactChatEmptyTitleSheet: What should change in this sheet?
artifactChatEmptySource: Continues “{{title}}”, so Kun keeps the context that made this file.
artifactChatEmptyNew: The first message starts a conversation in {{project}} with {{file}} attached.
artifactChatQuickPromptSlidesLayout: Check every slide for layout problems (overflowing text, misaligned or overlapping elements, inconsistent fonts) and fix them.
artifactChatQuickPromptSlidesStyle: Make fonts, sizes and colors consistent across the whole deck.
artifactChatQuickPromptSlidesNotes: Write concise speaker notes for every slide.
artifactChatQuickPromptSlidesSplit: This slide is too dense; split it into two slides.
artifactChatQuickPromptDocProofread: Proofread the document and fix typos and grammar without changing the meaning.
artifactChatQuickPromptDocFormal: Rewrite the selected passage (or the whole document) in a more formal tone.
artifactChatQuickPromptDocSummary: Add a short summary at the top of the document.
artifactChatQuickPromptDocTerms: Make terminology consistent throughout the document.
artifactChatQuickPromptSheetExplain: Explain what this sheet contains and how its formulas work. Don't change the file.
artifactChatQuickPromptSheetTotals: Add a totals row below the data, calculated with formulas.
artifactChatQuickPromptSheetOutliers: Find unusual values in this sheet and highlight them.
artifactChatQuickPromptSheetChart: Add a chart that shows the key numbers in this sheet.
artifactChatNoticeNoChange: This turn didn't change the file.
artifactChatNoticeExternal: The file changed outside Kun; the preview is up to date.
artifactChatNoticeRestored: Restored the earlier version. What it replaced is kept in Versions.
artifactChatBusyOther: “{{title}}” is still working on something else; your message waits its turn.
artifactChatEditing: Kun is changing this file; the preview refreshes when it's done.
artifactChatVersionsEmpty: After Kun changes this file from the chat, the version before each turn appears here.
